Lauren / Aditya — my redlines and asks:

1) Probation vs at-will / first-90-days language
- The draft currently uses the word "probationary period" which has legal implications in some states. Prefer wording: "The first 90 days will include a performance review; employment remains at-will." Please update.

2) Severance language
- Samantha is Senior PM (IC). Our standard is no severance below Director level unless explicitly agreed. Marcus wants some guarantee for relocation costs if terminated without cause within 6 months. Suggest: a capped relocation reimbursement clause rather than severance.

3) Sign-on payment timing
- If we approve the $20k sign-on, propose split: 50% on start, 50% after 6 months (conditions: active employment). Need finance confirmation that this is acceptable.

4) Equity commencement & vesting dates
- Confirm that vesting commences on official start date and that we honor the usual 'accelerated repurchase on termination' language. Also confirm the grant size maps to CB-3 median.

5) Background check / I-9 / visa language
- Candidate indicated she is US-based but will be traveling overseas at start. Add explicit background check + I-9 completion prior to payroll start; clarify remote-first first-week accommodations.

6) Remote-work stipend & home office
- Candidate asked about a one-time remote setup stipend during screening. Recommend a $1k stipend; confirm with People Ops.

Please redline the template and return the version to me and Dev.

Evelyn Hart
VP, Product Operations
